question: The graph of the angle of deviation ($\delta$) versus the angle of incidence ($i$) for a triangular prism is a U-shaped curve. Why does a horizontal line drawn above the minimum point intersect the curve at two distinct points?

options.A: Because the prism has two refracting surfaces.
options.B: Because of the principle of reversibility of light.
options.C: Because light splits into two components.
options.D: Because the refractive index varies with angle.
